summary: Compose IRQL (Incident Response Query Language) queries for Kusto cybersecurity investigations. Translates natural language hunting questions into composable IRQL pipelines using Get_*, Extract_*, and Enrich_* functions.
whenToUse: Use when the user explicitly wants IRQL: composing security hunting pipelines from Get_, Extract_ and Enrich_ functions in Kusto.
whenNotToUse: Generic security queries that don't ask for IRQL
